cases.name: Historical dual-citizen route control
cases.subject: Business Bachelor application route and diploma recognition
cases.email_text: Dear Admissions Team, I am a dual citizen (French and Moroccan), currently residing in Morocco and holding a French Baccalauréat diploma. I want to apply for the English-taught Bachelor’s in Business but am unsure whether I should apply as an EU applicant or international. Also, would my French diploma fulfill the general university entrance requirements, or would I need to obtain a VPD from Uni-Assist?

cases.subject: International Business application with pending final results
cases.email_text: My name is Ananya and I’m currently completing my final year in BBA at the University of Delhi. I would like to apply for the Master’s in International Business starting next fall. Could you please let me know how pending transcripts are handled during the application review?

cases.name: IB/SAT/Duolingo English proof and late certificate
cases.subject: English language proof for Business Administration
cases.email_text:
Dear Admissions Office,

I am an international applicant interested in applying for the Bachelor's program in Business Administration (Betriebswirtschaftslehre) for the Winter Semester 2026/2027 at HTW Berlin.
I would like to kindly inquire whether my application can be considered under the current language requirements. I have completed the full International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme entirely in English, and I also hold a Duolingo English Test result (C1). In addition, I have achieved a total score of 1320 on the SAT.
Could you please confirm whether my IB studies or SAT score can serve as proof of English proficiency, or if an additional recognized test such as TOEFL or IELTS is still required?
In case neither of these is acceptable, I would like to kindly ask whether I may be allowed to submit an approved language certificate at a later date—either after the application deadline or upon conditional acceptance.
Thank you very much for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Amy.

cases.name: DAAD EPOS application resubmission with attachments
cases.subject: Resubmission of DAAD EPOS scholarship application
cases.email_text:
I hope this message finds you well.

Following a delivery failure to the previously indicated address, I am hereby resubmitting my complete application for the DAAD EPOS scholarship for the MBA in International Management at HTW Berlin (2025 intake) via this official applicant mailbox.

Please find attached the following documents for your kind consideration:

Completed and signed DAAD application form (PDF)

Motivation letter (PDF)

Curriculum Vitae (PDF)

Degree certificate and academic transcripts (PDF)

English translation of academic transcript (PDF)

Proof of employment at Trankyl Togo (PDF)

Copy of my passport (PDF)

Should you require any additional information or clarification, I remain at your full disposal.

Thank you very much for your time and kind consideration.

Best regards,
